disclaimer: This obligation catalog is a versioned decision-support draft pending independent review for package conformance and prior-art diligence screening. It is not legal advice, not a completeness certification, and does not authorize filing, payment, signature, or docket mutation. MPEP entries are guidance tier and are never silently elevated above 37 C.F.R. or Title 35. Form instructions are not controlling law. Unknown authority fails closed to unknown. Exhaustive prior-art diligence means required corpora are searched or residual gaps are explicitly named — never asserts absence of all prior art and never a legal patentability opinion. Named human review is required before any export or assurance disposition.
notes: PAAR-053/054 seed v1.1.0: core utility filing components + expanded MPEP/CFR crosswalk (format, inventorship, priority, IDS, 112 diligence, PCT ISR) and exhaustive multi-corpus prior-art obligations (US/ODP, foreign/EPO OPS, NPL). MPEP is guidance tier only. Not a literal every-paragraph MPEP dump; remaining coverage gaps must surface as unknown, never silent pass. Not legal advice; never legal patentability opinions; never Sign/Pay/Submit/auto-IDS.
